courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 杜拜地鐵紅線
related.transfer: 可遷移「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」與「牽引饋線壓降」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；杜拜地鐵紅線的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Communication delay and stale position" and "Traction feeder voltage drop" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Dubai Metro Red Line must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦地下自動化捷運牽引通訊與疏散；杜拜地鐵紅線則以沙漠都市自動捷運熱管理與高架介面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on underground automated metro traction communication and egress; Dubai Metro Red Line centres on desert urban automated metro thermal and elevated interfaces, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」與「通風散熱與設備溫升」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到杜拜地鐵紅線，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「垂直動線有效輸送率」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Communication delay and stale position” and “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Dubai Metro Red Line, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Vertical circulation throughput", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 新加坡東北地鐵線
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2003 年：新加坡東北地鐵線開始營運服務；2024 年：東北線榜鵝海岸站於十二月開放營運。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以新加坡東北地鐵線為背景，建立全地下自動運轉的教學案例。課程把供電、定位、車門與通風連成系統事件鏈，並以通訊失效和列車停在站間的情境檢查旅客資訊、備援能源及復原次序。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2003: Singapore’s North East Line entered passenger service; 2024: Punggol Coast station on the North East Line opened in December. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Singapore’s North East Line as the setting for an underground automated-operation teaching case. Connect power, localisation, doors and ventilation through system events. Use lost communication and an interstation stop to test passenger information, backup energy and recovery sequence, while distinguishing a reliable data link from the proof that a movement is safely authorised. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.
